properties.description: Checks every presented data beat against the ordered accepted prefix, completion-justified zero padding, clamped output length and final-byte marker, independently of readiness. Meaningful unknown payloads cannot pass.

Checks every presented status against the next completed accepted frame: exact original length, length clamped to 4..8, padding and truncation flags. Status inventory is consumed independently of data inventory.
Checks that blocked data and status retain valid and meaningful payload across edges, except when synchronous reset cancels the obligation.
Checks that both response valids are clear after a reset edge. Reset discards epoch inventories and blocked-transfer obligations, but does not erase earlier alarms.

Checks source reset and blocked-offer protocol, meaningful observation knownness, accepted input lengths of 1..12 bytes and bounded inventory capacity. Input-contract alarms are not evidence of a DUT defect.

Enabled combinationally by the final-post marker, checks that no input fragment, data response, status response or presented valid remains, with ready-high reset-low idle completion conditions. Requires at least 32 idle edges and supports 128-cycle final tails; the evaluator separately enforces its final minimum tail. This is finite completion, not unbounded liveness.
